free.a: Yes. Posting jobs and bidding are free right now.

contact.q: When do I get the phone number?
contact.a: As soon as a publisher awards your bid, you both see each other's phone number on the job page and by email. Before that, numbers are never shown.

choose.q: Do I have to take the lowest bid?
choose.a: No. Compare rates, ratings, completed jobs and messages, and award whoever you trust most.

broker.q: I bring a crew. Can I bid for all of them?
broker.a: Yes — turn on the Broker role in settings and you can bid for several workers at once.

pay.q: How do I pay the workers?
pay.a: You pay workers directly, as you agree on the phone. CoConnect does not handle wages.

safety.q: How do you keep it safe?
safety.a: Every job is moderated, contact details are private until award, and anyone can report a post or person.

rejected.q: My job was sent back. What now?
rejected.a: The moderator's reason is on your job page. Edit the job and submit it again.

multi.q: Can I hire more than one broker for one job?
multi.a: Yes. Award several bids until you have all the workers you need, or stop hiring at any time.

complete.q: What happens when the work is done?
complete.a: Either side marks it complete and the other confirms (or it confirms itself after 7 days). Then you can both leave a review.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: Email support from your account's email address. We delete your data within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep.

legal.draftNotice: Draft for legal review. This page summarises how CoConnect works and must be reviewed by a lawyer before public launch.

intermediary.p: CoConnect connects people who need work done with workers and brokers. We are not an employer, contractor or agent of any user, and we do not direct, supervise or guarantee any work.

accounts.p: You must give accurate information, keep your password safe, and use one account. You are responsible for activity on your account.

posting.p: Jobs must be real, lawful and in the right category, and rates should meet legal minimum wages. Moderators may reject, edit-request or remove any post.

bidding.p: A bid is an offer. When a publisher awards a bid, both parties' phone numbers are shared so they can agree the details directly.

conduct.p: No harassment, scams, discrimination, or attempts to bypass the platform by posting contact details. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

fees.p: Posting is currently free. If fees are introduced, they will be shown before you submit, and bank transfers are verified manually.

liability.p: Agreements about work and payment are between users. To the extent the law allows, CoConnect is not liable for losses arising from those agreements.

changes.p: We may update these terms and will notify you of important changes.

collect.p: Your name, email, mobile number, district and town, profile details, the jobs, bids, reviews and messages you post, and basic technical logs.

use.p: To run the marketplace, moderate content, prevent abuse, send notifications and improve the service. We follow Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022.

share.p: Your public profile (name, district, ratings) is visible to everyone. Job posts are public once approved. Bids are visible only to you and the job's publisher.

phone.p: Your number is never shown publicly. It is shared only with the other party when a job is awarded.

retention.p: We keep your data while your account is active and delete it within 30 days of a deletion request, except records the law requires us to keep.

rights.p: You can access, correct or delete your data, and withdraw consent, by contacting us.

security.p: Data is stored with access controls on every table, private storage for payment slips, and location data removed from photos.

contact.p: For privacy questions or to report a data breach, email support from your account's email address.
